Upcoming Sales

Coverage of our sales are live streamed to NZB’s website and Facebook page, as well as Freeview Channel 200 and SKY Channel 263  in New Zealand. Selling generally begins at 10am (NZT) each day.

All interested parties are welcome to attend sales at the Karaka Sales Centre, where various bars and cafes onsite are open to the general public right next to the selling action. 

- To view the live broadcast online, visit nzb.co.nz and click on the Sale link. This will bring you to the catalogue and live video stream, where results will be updated regularly throughout the Sale.

- The action can also be viewed from the live stream on NZB’s facebook page: facebook.com/NewZealandBloodstock.
